name: net_prologue_mansion_axel_form
description: FM-02 rehearsal route (the committed Computer Room -> Basement Hall pilot, both Dusk waves) into Axel II, 02/14 btl137 (checked site tt20-137). Both default Roxas seats must build the native encounter body 0x323 (P_EX110_BTLF) for their local and their clone of the other seat, with both keyblades, and release together. Inside the combat-admission hold, one synthetic 1-HP native hit lands on each seat's clone: the observer's own HP, its SAVE character record (Sora/Roxas, SAVE+0x24F0) and the drive-form rows (SAVE+0x32F4, the row the clone's status +0x254 references) must not change. Each owner then moves, jumps and attacks alone, filmed on both seats; each owner is downed once (DownedSpike fixture Kill) and revived by the other seat; then both are downed and the host takes the native Continue to the Computer Room 02/15 d99, where no dual-wield body or old clone may remain. Video-only paired clips (lead amendment). Rehearsal save, no save.
